name: hx_constant_pinch
title: Heat exchanger with an imposed pinch (three zones)
summary: Condenser sized by an imposed pinch and subcooling: three refrigerant zones (desuperheating, condensation, subcooling) against a single-phase coolant, with the saturation pressure closed by the pinch condition. Translation of the LaboThapPy HexCstPinch condenser branch.

verification.reference: LaboThapPy COND_CO2 example run in a throw-away venv (CoolProp 8.0.0, solved: True, pinch residual 5e-10 K) plus a clean re-run driving the original system_cond with an independent brentq (agrees to 1e-7)
verification.notes: State enthalpies <= 0.3 % (subcooled outlet 1.7 %), P_sat 0.33 %, zone duties sh/tp <= 1.6 %, pinch exact. Q_dot 2.8 % off: LaboThapPy evaluates h 0.1 K below saturation with BICUBIC tables (dh 5607 J/kg, implies cp 56 kJ/kgK) vs HEOS 608 J/kg (cp 6.0 kJ/kgK, used by CoolSolve) - artifact of the original backend, translation faithful. LaboThapPy fluid name CO2 maps to EES R744 (bare CO2 is the ideal-gas species in EES).
